test_std_exception: test that pybind11 throws a standard RuntimeError with the expected message string
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that pybind11 cross-module exceptions like RuntimeError and ValueError propagate correctly across modules
test_custom: test custom pybind11 exception types including MyException subclassing and helper-declared exception translation
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling and propagation across language boundaries
test_flaky_exception_failure_point_init: test pybind11 error_already_set behavior when a flaky exception fails during its init constructor
